summary: Create a rulebook activation (Content Consumer, with a project and decision environment) under Automation Decisions > Rulebook Activations: name, organization, project, rulebook and zero or more credentials, limited to Vault, Red Hat AAP (only one allowed) and custom types.
questions: How do I create a rulebook activation?
Which credentials can I attach to a rulebook activation?
Can I attach two AAP credentials to one activation?
